p10_statement: P10 cannot be computed from the records (no per-slot gate decision and no MMPP state are written); it is not evaluated. The open fraction by load below is descriptive only.
b_reason: the test records hold no per-slot gate decision (only the per-minute share cons_rate, tpa/run/metrics.py) and no MMPP state (tpa/run/evaluator.py writes run and minute rows only); the MMPP state is policy-independent and could be regenerated from (seed, block, test run), but it is not in the records
base_share_note: stationary share of slots within w = 100 slots after a level change of any zone for mmpp_p_stay = [0.98, 0.95], Z = 6: the frozen ratio is ~1 whatever the gate does, so it could not discriminate even with per-slot records; on a finite run it is about N / (N - c1 - 1) ~ 1.0007 > 1 for ANY gate (the slots before the first level change lie in the warm-up, where the gate cannot open), i.e. biased toward confirming P10
